facts.fact: Kayla 在 The Pit 酒吧上周六夜班，前男友 Kyle（外号 Douchenugget）分手近两个月仍每隔几天来店里盯着她
facts.anchor: We broke up almost two months ago, but he still comes in here every few days.

facts.fact: Kyle 带来的红发女伴骂 Kayla 是 stalker bitch，老板 Rogue 直接把她面前的冰水泼向女伴，还美其名曰「降温」
facts.anchor: Rogue bounces over to me; she is always full of energy. She snatches up the glass of ice water in front of me and throws it at the woman. “We cool them down.”

facts.fact: Kayla 分手后只租得起 Mabel 家楼上的阁楼：半聋老太太电视开到音量 100，还总想把她那住家里抽大麻的孙子介绍给她
facts.anchor: Now all I can afford is the loft apartment over Mabel’s house, a half-deaf, lovely old woman, who has her television on volume 100 and lectures about safe sex whenever I bring someone home.

facts.fact: 吧台尽头出现一个不碰酒、不挪窝的盯梢男，像在把她的一举一动编目归档，让她首次感到发毛
facts.anchor: I can feel his gaze the entire time—he hasn’t moved, and he hasn’t touched his drink.

facts.fact: 当面对峙时对方只答「Just watching」，嘲讽她自以为有权力，问完名字又说不重要——只是好奇
facts.anchor: “It doesn’t,” he simply says. “Color me curious.”

facts.fact: Kayla 自认个性缺陷是不怕任何事，但「最糟的事都发生在自家安全屋」是她亲身体会——全书最早的创伤暗示
facts.anchor: One of my personality flaws is that I’m not scared of anything. Should I be? Yes, but really the worst shit that can happen to you will happen in the safety of your own home—I know that from firsthand experience.

facts.fact: 便利店结账时她与陌生年轻男子接梗：从纸袋杀人聊到 paper cuts 死法和酒水刑
facts.anchor: “I would like to see one about murdering someone with a recycled paper bag. Death via paper cuts.”

facts.fact: 男子临走叫她 paper-cut princess，留下「恐惧在于你享受了什么、直到发现该逃开怪物」的判词
facts.anchor: “Paper-cut princess, fear isn’t about being scared.” A small smile curves his mouth. “It’s about what you enjoy before you realize you should’ve run and not involved yourself with monsters.”
